description: T-3410: what Excel for the web gives for the two ironcalc-calc cells whose cached values come from another Excel build. IRR at an exact zero root: flows {-4,4} (IRR.xlsx Two Values!C4 caches 2^-52), the same with an explicit guess, reversed signs, {-1,1}, and three flows {-2,1,1} whose exact root is 0; A4:B4 hold -4 and 4 as in IRR.xlsx. IMCOS of 4+3i (COMPLEXs.xlsx Sheet1!K25 caches the imaginary part as 7.58155274274655 from Mac Excel).
